cities.description: A figure of the network strip: how many cities the trains serve.

track.description: A figure of the network strip: the length of the network, in the `distance` named format (kilometres).

travellers.description: A figure of the network strip: how many people travelled, in the `compact` named format (1.2M).

countries.description: The line under the network strip; the countries arrive as one list already formatted in the visitor's language.
